thread.title: Authorities Identify Remains of 14 Victims in Tennessee Explosion
thread.title_full: Authorities Identify Remains of 14 Victims in Tennessee Explosion

author: Associated Press
title: Authorities Identify Remains of 14 Victims in Tennessee Explosion
text:
• Authorities have identified the remains of 14 victims from an explosion in Tennessee.
• The identification was confirmed by the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation using a 'rapid DNA' process.
• Victims' ages range from 25 to 60 years old.
• Humphreys County Sheriff Chris Davis stated that the identification provides families with a sense of closure.
• The process of clearing the scene and processing evidence is expected to take weeks.
• Sheriff Davis indicated that it may take up to two months to fully assess the scene.
• Jamey VanVliet, special agent in charge of the Nashville division of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives, noted that significant work remains at the site.
• The explosion occurred at Accurate Energetic Systems, a company that supplies explosives for the military.
• The company's facility spans 1,300 acres and includes eight specialized production buildings and a lab.
• The initial blast was felt over 20 miles away, resulting in extensive damage at the plant.
• Authorities have removed hazardous materials and live explosives from the scene but caution that more may be uncovered.
• The specific materials involved in the explosion have not been disclosed, and the investigation is ongoing.
• Accurate Energetic Systems has received numerous military contracts for various munitions and explosives.
